state.empty.kitchen.title: Your kitchen is empty
state.empty.kitchen.body: Tell me what you have — "2 kilo aloo, ek dozen ande"
state.offline.title: You're offline
state.error.title: Something went wrong
state.error.body: That's on us. Try again in a moment.
kitchen.title: Kitchen
cook.title: Cook With Me
cook.empty: Pick a dish on Home to start cooking.
you.title: You
mic.label: Talk to Cookmate
onb.welcome.title: Your kitchen, decided.
onb.welcome.body: Tell me what's in your kitchen and who eats here. I'll pick what to cook and guide you step by step, by voice, in your language.
onb.welcome.error: Couldn't start. Check your internet and try again.
onb.language.title: Choose your language
onb.language.speak: Apni bhasha chuniye. Choose your language.
onb.members.title: Who eats here?
onb.members.body: Add everyone you cook for, up to 6 people. You can change this later.
onb.members.name: Name
onb.spice.title: How spicy do you like it?
onb.spice.body: Children start mild. I'll learn from your feedback.
onb.diet.title: What does your home eat?
onb.diet.body: This applies to everyone for now. You can set each person on the You tab.
onb.consent.title: Your kitchen, your choice
onb.consent.body: Turn on what you're comfortable with. You can change this anytime.
consent.voice_processing.title: Cook by voice
consent.voice_processing.body: Your voice is turned into text so I can understand you. Recordings are not kept.
consent.memory.title: Remember what we learn
consent.memory.body: Keep tastes from your feedback, like "more garlic next time". You can see and forget each one.
consent.analytics.title: Help improve Cookmate
consent.analytics.body: Share usage counts. Never what you say or cook.
onb.error.create: Couldn't set up your kitchen. Your choices are saved; try again.
kitchen.addPlaceholder: Type it like you'd say it: "2 kilo aloo, ek dozen ande, thoda atta"
kitchen.confirmBody: Fix anything that's wrong, then add.
kitchen.parseEmpty: I couldn't find any items. Try "2 kilo aloo".
kitchen.addError: Couldn't add these. Your list is still here; try again.
item.notFound: This item is no longer in your kitchen.
home.nothingFits.title: Nothing fits that yet
home.nothingFits.body: Try fewer filters, or tell me what's in your kitchen.
home.useSoonHint: Tap one to cook with it
home.focusNone: No dish here uses {item} yet; these are the best of the rest
recipe.draft: Draft: our kitchen hasn't tested this yet
search.title: Search recipes
search.hint: Type a dish or an ingredient, in any language.
search.noneBody: Try another name, or one of its ingredients.
adapt.title: Your way
adapt.body: Tell me what to change. Tested rules come first, and safety steps never change.
adapt.unresolved: Nothing in your kitchen can replace {items} here. Add to the list?
quick.cta: Quick start: what did you cook yesterday?
quick.ctaBody: I'll guess what's in your kitchen from it.
quick.title: What did you cook yesterday?
quick.body: Pick the dish. I'll add what it needs as guesses, marked "Still have this?" until you say yes.
quick.none: {dish}: everything it needs is already in your kitchen
quick.addedBody: They won't count towards picks until you confirm them in Kitchen.
cook.resume.title: Still cooking {dish}?
cook.notSynced: Couldn't save your place just now. Keep cooking; it's safe on this phone.
cook.timer.label: Step {n}
cook.timer.silent: Notifications are off, so timers only ring while Cookmate is open.
cook.whistle.title: Count the whistles
finish.title: {dish} is ready!
finish.body: Three quick things. Skip any of them.
finish.deduct: Take these out of your kitchen?
finish.deductBody: Change any amount, or switch a line off.
finish.deductNone: Nothing on your kitchen list was used.
finish.leftoversBody: They go in your fridge list, so we remind you to finish them.
finish.failed: Couldn't save that. Try again, or skip.
rescue.title: What's wrong?
rescue.body: Tap one. You'll get a fix for this dish with what's in your kitchen.
rescue.offline: Showing our standard fix; we couldn't reach the kitchen brain.
voice.title: Talk to Cookmate
voice.soon.title: Voice isn't switched on yet
voice.soon.body: Until it is, you can type what you have or what you feel like eating.
voice.consent.title: Voice needs your permission
voice.consent.body: You haven't allowed Cookmate to process your voice. You can keep using it by typing.
voice.ready.title: Voice is ready on our side
voice.ready.body: Talking arrives with the next app update. Until then, type instead.
assist.ask.title: What do you want to know?
assist.ask.hint: e.g. Can I use oil instead of ghee?
assist.changed.title: What did you change?
assist.changed.hint: e.g. I added the tomatoes early
assist.step: You're on step {n}: your place is kept.
assist.offline: This is our standard answer; the kitchen brain couldn't be reached.
you.empty: Nothing yet. Cookmate learns as you cook and say how it went.
you.learnedBody: Everything here can be changed or forgotten.
finish.rememberBody: Tap what Cookmate should remember. You can change it later in You.
list.title: Shopping list
list.emptyBody: Missing items from a recipe and staples that run low show up here.
list.allBoughtBody: Bought items go straight into your kitchen.
home.remembered: Remembered. You can change it in You.
you.tell.title: Tell me something
you.tell.more: A little more {item} in recipes from now on
you.tell.less: A little less {item} in recipes from now on
you.tell.plain: Kept just as you said it
you.prefsBody: Picks leave out what anyone eating avoids.
you.prefsEmpty: Nothing yet. Add what someone avoids or loves.
you.prefUnknown: I don't know "{item}" yet. Try another name for it.
you.savedEmpty: Tap the heart on a dish to keep it here.
you.voice.title: How I talk to you
you.voice.body: For voice cooking and when steps are read aloud.
you.phone.title: Keep your kitchen safe
you.phone.body: Add your phone number so you can get everything back on a new phone. Nothing here changes.
you.phone.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or send a new one.
you.phone.taken: This number is already used by another account.
you.phone.notReady: Phone sign-in isn't switched on yet. Your kitchen is still saved on this phone.
you.privacy.title: Privacy
you.privacy.exportBody: Everything Cookmate keeps about your household, in one file.
you.privacy.deleteHint: Removes your account and the kitchens only you own.
you.privacy.deleteBody: This deletes your account now. Kitchens that only you own are deleted with everything in them: pantry, memories, cooking history. In a kitchen someone else also runs, you are removed and they keep it. This can't be undone.
cook.offline: No network. Keep cooking: everything is saved on this phone and will sync when you're back online.
cook.hf.start: Hands-free: listen for next, back, repeat and timers
cook.hf.listening: Listening. Say "next", "back", "repeat", or "10 minute timer". Works without network.
cook.hf.denied: The microphone is off for Cookmate. Turn it on in your phone's settings to cook hands-free.
cook.hf.unavailable: Hands-free listening isn't available on this phone. Tap Next and Back instead.
cook.hf.hint: Say next, back, repeat, or a timer.
cook.hf.lastStep: This is the last step. Say "done" when the dish is ready.
finish.offline: You're offline, so we'll take the recipe's amounts off your kitchen when you're back online. You can fix any item in Kitchen after that.
home.check.title: Still have {item}?
home.fast.title: Keeping the {name} fast today?
home.invent: Make something new from what's here
invent.title: Something new
invent.loading: Putting your odds and ends together…
invent.note: A new creation, not a tested recipe. It passed our food-safety checks; taste as you go.
invent.tooLittle.title: Not much to work with
invent.tooLittle.body: This works best with leftovers, homemade chutneys or things about to spoil. Add them in Kitchen.
invent.unsafe.title: Couldn't come up with something safe
invent.unsafe.body: Nothing we thought of passed our food-safety checks, so we won't suggest it. Try again in a bit.
invent.unavailable.title: Not switched on yet
invent.unavailable.body: Inventing new dishes isn't available yet. Your picks still work as usual.
you.notify.title: Daily dinner idea
you.notify.body: One gentle note a day with tonight's pick, never during quiet hours.
you.notify.denied: Notifications for Cookmate are off in your phone's settings.
you.notify.noDevice: This phone can't receive it yet. It starts once Cookmate is installed from the store.
you.notify.badTime: That time is inside quiet hours.
home.fast.none.title: No fasting dishes yet
home.fast.none.body: Cookmate doesn't have dishes for this fast yet; more are being added.
onb.w.title: Meet your kitchen helper.
onb.w.body: Cookmate knows what you have, understands what you feel like eating, and guides you step by step when it's time to cook.
onb.w.f1.title: Knows your kitchen
onb.w.f1.body: Remembers what's in your fridge, shelves and freezer. No lists to keep.
onb.w.f2.title: Knows your taste
onb.w.f2.body: Learns what your family likes, your food rules and how spicy you cook.
onb.w.f3.title: Cooks with you
onb.w.f3.body: Talks you through every step, hands-free, and tells you what to look, listen and smell for.
onb.k.title: Let's see what's in your kitchen.
onb.k.body: Tap what you usually have. I'll remember it and suggest dishes you can make.
onb.k.scan.title: Scan with your camera
onb.k.scan.body: Point your phone at the fridge or shelf and I'll spot what's there.
onb.k.empty: Nothing yet. Tap things below to add them.
onb.k.own: Or add your own (e.g. leftover dal)
onb.k.tip: With these {n} things I can already suggest {count} dishes, like {dishes}.
onb.k.tipOne: With these {n} things I can already suggest {dishes}.
onb.k.tipNone: Add a few more things and I'll start finding dishes you can make.
onb.f.title: Who eats here?
onb.f.body: Add everyone you cook for. I'll make sure each plate suits them.
onb.f.dietNote: You can set this per person later.
onb.f.diet.nonveg: Meat, fish and egg are fine
onb.f.diet.jain: No onion, garlic or root vegetables
onb.f.diet.vegan: No milk, ghee or curd either
onb.t.title: Now tell me what you love.
onb.t.body: I'll match spice, flavours and cooking time to how your family eats.
onb.t.spiceNote: For grown-ups. Children get it milder.
onb.t.spiceSay.1: No chilli at all. Gentle and soothing.
onb.t.spiceSay.2: A little warmth from ginger and pepper, hardly any chilli.
onb.t.spiceSay.3: Everyday home spice: a green chilli in the tadka.
onb.t.spiceSay.4: You like a proper kick from red chilli and green chillies.
onb.t.cuisinesBody: Pick the kinds of food you enjoy most.
onb.t.paceBody: How much time do you usually have?
onb.t.pace.quickBody: One-pan dishes, simple steps, little washing up.
onb.t.pace.relaxed: I like to take my time
onb.t.pace.relaxedBody: Slow-cooked dals, curries and weekend specials too.
onb.t.avoidBody: I'll leave these out of every dish.
onb.t.unknown: I don't know that one yet. Try another name for it.
